packageRules.description: Automerge patch/minor/digest/pin once the MR pipeline passes. The pipeline runs all scanners as REQUIRED jobs on MRs (they must execute), and new Critical/High findings are blocked by the Scan Result Policy (issue #2, task 4.2) — enable that policy before turning the Renovate schedule on. Majors always need manual review + Duo.
Group and label the Docker/CI base-image (node:22-alpine) bumps together.

Defer ESLint 10 (#21/!51): no released eslint-plugin-react supports it (latest 7.37.5 peers eslint ^3||...||^9.7, pinned via eslint-config-next). Lift this line once the Next plugin chain ships ESLint-10 support - Renovate will re-propose the major automatically.

Defer TypeScript 7 (!68): TS 7 is the Go-native compiler; @typescript-eslint 8.62.1 peers typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0 (via eslint-config-next), so typescript-estree crashes at module load and lint/build fail. The <6.1 ceiling matches that peer range and still lets Renovate propose TS 6.0.x (the JS-based sibling release). This cap also applies to vulnerabilityAlerts MRs (Renovate does not auto-bypass allowedVersions for security fixes) - accepted trade-off: typescript is a devDependency (never in the runtime bundle), TS itself rarely carries CVEs, and a TS-7-only fix would crash this same lint toolchain regardless, so the real remediation is lifting this defer. Lift this line once the typescript-eslint chain ships TS-7 support - Renovate will re-propose the major automatically.
